    int solve(int n, int k, int s, long long t) {
        while (t % n != 0) {
            int delta = (s < k ? 1 : -1) * (int)(t % n);
            s = (s + n + delta) % n;
            t--;
        }

        t /= n;

        vector<long long> when(n, -1);

        for (long long left = t; left > 0; left--) {

                        return i;
                    }

                throw runtime_error("Assertion error");

            when[s] = left;

            for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                if (s < k) {
                    s += i;
                    if (s >= n) {
                        s -= n;
                    }
                } else {
                    s -= i;
                    if (s < 0) {
                        s += n;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return s;
    }

    int go(int n, int m) {
        vector<int> a(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = i;

        for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {

                a[j] = (a[j] + n + i * delta) % n;

        return maxDepth(a);

    int maxDepth(const vector<int>& p) {
        int n = p.size();
        vector<int> used(n, -1);
        int ret = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int cur = 0;
            int v = i;
            while (used[v] != i) {
                used[v] = i;
                cur++;
                v = p[v];
            }
            ret = max(ret, cur);
        }
        return ret;
    }

            }
            b = readByte();

private:
    static int readByte() {

        static int bufSz = 0, bufPtr = 0;
        if (bufSz == -1)
            throw runtime_error("Reading past EOF");
        if (bufPtr >= bufSz) {
            bufPtr = 0;
            bufSz = fread(buf, 1, 1 << 14, stdin);
            if (bufSz <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[bufPtr++];
    }

    static bool isTrash(int c) {
        return c < 33 || c > 126;
    }

    static int skip() {
        int b;
        while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && isTrash(b))
            ;
